name: Roscoe J. (Ross) Gorman
prior_offices: Converse County coroner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Roscoe J. Gorman, also listed as Ross Gorman, is the Converse County coroner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official general election summary lists him as the winner of the coroner race.
